scope: Every input of every threat-dynamics machine is a Source. Until a milestone stages its producer, it is a simulated Source with SURFACE_SPEC.md create-body semantics, one per input cell (TD-SD-04, GOV-SD-16).

simulationRule.sources: SURFACE_SPEC.md Sources & Sensors, POST /api/sources create body, type simulated
simulationRule.sample: v = dcOffset + amplitude * f(phase), phase = fmod(t * frequency, 1), t = globalStep (+0.1 per cell; every Source here is one cell); binary = 1 while phase < 0.5
simulationRule.excluded: sine (rounding), random-walk and gaussian-noise (not deterministic across runtimes)
simulationRule.reset: POST {re}/api/engine/reset and POST {pe}/api/reset before each simulation (SURFACE_SPEC: reset is layer-local)
simulationRule.authority: the voting engines, 3-of-3; expectedOutputsByStep is this package's authoring evaluator
